استوزروا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْزَرُوا (istawzarū) /is.taw.za.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
# اُسْتُوزِرُوا (ustūzirū) /us.tuː.zi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
# اِسْتَوْزِرُوا (istawzirū) /is.taw.zi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْزَرَ (istawzara)
